source.title: Coveted Bauble — Spinsoa and Saccratros exchanges

notes: One-for-one coin to Warband-bound bauble exchange; unlike the six Season 2 crest chests, sources describe this as the continuing coin sink.
Vendor exchanges 50 Coveted Baubles for one Diamondshell pet or mount item. Output is a collectible, not an auctionable reagent.
Vendor exchanges 100 Coveted Baubles for one Subterranean Magmammoth pet or mount item. Output is a collectible, not an auctionable reagent.
Vendor exchanges 400 Coveted Baubles for one Igneous Shalewing pet or mount item. Output is a collectible, not an auctionable reagent.
